proposed.explanation: Pagoda is a vertical Buddhist monument of multiple diminishing stories, not a gate structure. Jali is a perforated stone screen used in Mughal architecture, not a Japanese Shinto gate. Gopura is a Hindu gateway tower, not a Shinto gate. Torii is explicitly defined as a simple post-and-lintel gate structure marking Shinto sacred boundaries; at Fushimi Inari, thousands of vermillion torii tunnel up the mountainside, creating ascending gradations of sacred space.
